verdicts.name: MATCHED
verdicts.description: Observed evidence covered by the proof level agrees with the expectation.

verdicts.name: STALE
verdicts.description: Direct evidence binds the running subject to a known older artifact than the current expectation.

verdicts.name: LEAKED
verdicts.description: The identified subject resolves outside every allowed runtime root.

verdicts.name: CONFLICT
verdicts.description: Multiple incompatible active artifacts or equally trusted expectations prevent a unique result.

verdicts.name: NOT_RUNNING
verdicts.description: A complete permitted scan found no process for the requested subject.

verdicts.name: UNKNOWN
verdicts.description: Available evidence is insufficient for a safe deterministic verdict.

proof_levels.name: PROCESS_OBSERVED
proof_levels.description: A PID plus creation time and bounded process metadata were observed.

proof_levels.name: CONFIG_BOUND
proof_levels.description: The process is bound to a declared local host configuration or expectation.

proof_levels.name: ARTIFACT_OBSERVED
proof_levels.description: Declared entrypoint or payload bytes were read and hashed during observation.

proof_levels.name: LAUNCH_WITNESSED
proof_levels.description: ARP hashed the declared payload before spawning and recorded the resulting process identity.

reason_codes.description: All evidence required by the reported proof level matches the expectation.
No process matched the requested subject in a complete permitted scan.
PID or creation-time identity changed while evidence was collected.
The operating system denied required process evidence without privilege escalation.
No expectation was supplied for a requested verification.
The supplied expectation failed structural or semantic validation.
The bytes match a declaration whose source is explicitly untrusted.
Multiple equally trusted expectations apply to the same binding.
An observed artifact digest differs from the expected digest.
A directly observed artifact version differs from the expected version.
File identity or metadata changed while the artifact was hashed.
File, byte, or time limits stopped the artifact scan before completion.
The operating system denied access to required artifact bytes.
A resolved artifact path escaped the declared root.
A symbolic link, junction, or reparse point violated the expectation policy.
Two artifact paths collide after contract path normalization.
The declared artifact contains a file type outside the v1 contract.
Timestamps suggest replacement after launch but no direct old digest is available.
A launch receipt directly binds the process to an older declared payload.
The subject runtime resolves outside all roots allowed by the expectation.
The same binding has live processes with incompatible artifact digests.
Host evidence cannot uniquely bind the process to one configured runtime.
A declared host configuration source cannot be read without additional privilege.
A host configuration source is malformed or uses unsupported executable constructs.
Witness created an observation-only receipt because no expectation was supplied.
The declared payload does not cover all dependencies that may be loaded dynamically.
The current operating system cannot expose evidence required for a stronger proof level.
The caller cancelled the scan before a complete result was available.
